title: Two Young Sisters with Doll in Garden, 1940s Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: An outdoor black-and-white snapshot depicting two young girls, captioned in ink on the front lower margin as 'Ingrid and Patty'. The younger girl on the left wears a light-colored dress with puffed sleeves and a wide collar while cradling a toy doll. Her older companion stands beside her in a knit cardigan sweater and patterned dress with a Peter Pan collar. They stand amid lush garden foliage and perennial greenery, with the distinctive front fender and horizontal grille of an early-1940s automobile parked behind the bushes.
